profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | TypeScript, Angular, React
profile.summary: Highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with over eight years of experience developing user-friendly, responsive, high-performance web applications. Proven experience in Angular, React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with a strong focus on delivering scalable solutions and leading cross-functional teams to success. Engineer with Full-stack experience but with specialized expertise in the Front End.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Orchestrated the development of various prominent front-end solutions including Search, Varsity Standings, Continue Watching, Wrestling Results, Contentful CMS, and Flexible Pricing plans, driving substantial improvements in customer engagement, retention metrics, subscription signups, and revenue growth.
- Utilized Fastly to implement caching and conduct a range of A/B experiments assessing user engagement and signup rates, gauging the efficacy of features.
- Developed and maintained a robust front-end architecture using modern frameworks like React.js and Angular, ensuring code scalability and reusability.
- Developed and integrated highly scalable APIs using Nest.js and TypeScript.
- Implemented server-side driven UI pages utilizing BFF (back-end for front-end) development.
- Provided mentorship to junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the team.
- Worked on-call shifts for production issues.
- Conducted interviews to assess and select candidates for engineering positions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designed and developed Front-End web applications using Angular, Rxjs, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
- Led a team of two engineers in designing and developing the FE solution for our Search page using Algolia Search, Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and SASS.
- Enhanced Search page performance through strategic enhancements to Algolia Search UI components, integrating custom debouncing functionality and analytics. Achieved a notable 40% reduction in API calls, generating substantial cost savings by maintaining compliance with API thresholds.
- Collaboratively engineered and crafted the front-end solution for the Wrestling Results web page alongside a dedicated team of five engineers.
- Collaborated closely with UX/UI designers to translate mobile responsive designs into responsive web interfaces using Figma, Storybook, HTML, CSS, and SASS.
- Worked with multiple testing frameworks writing unit, and E2E tests using Jest, Cypress, Jasmine, Karma, and Spectator.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Bootstrap (Framework) and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed sophisticated features for our IntelliChartPRO application tailored to the fields of 
  Dermatology, Plastic Surgery, and Ophthalmology.
- Led a team of six engineers in architecting and developing the entire stack of our Custom Forms 
  feature using Angular, Angular JS, .NET Web APIs, and MSSQL.
- Served as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for numerous high-visibility features, three of which 
  received acclaim from the sales team, facilitating smoother sales closures.
- Designed and developed complex APIs using REST Architecture.
- Collaborated closely with QA and Support to pinpoint defects and draft regression test plans for our 
  team.
- Crafted Confluence documents summarizing research conducted during Spike JIRA tickets, unit 
  testing protocols, ERD diagrams, and guidelines for utilizing new features.
- Partnered closely with product owners, Technical Owners, and UX Designers to seamlessly integrate 
  novel UI features into the software.
- Hosted workshops on implementing modern CSS techniques and strategies such as SASS 7-1 
  Pattern, BEM, Flexbox, and Grid layout.
- Used Angular Material and Bootstrap 3 for all our styling on new and existing features.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed our Search solution for our marketing center admin dashboard application 
   using Elasticsearch, Azure, Python, and Django.
- Utilized Angular Material, Bootstrap 3, and NGX Bootstrap to streamline the styling across our 
   applications.
- Led the modernization of our Call Center application from JavaScript and jQuery to Angular.
- Crafted and implemented a cutting-edge call center administrative dashboard leveraging Angular, 
   TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, and MySQL.
- Contributed to go-live deployments and conducted production testing for new applications.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Aided in resolving issues within established codebases.
- Supported the Development team in every facet of software design and coding.
- Developed a range of E2E and unit tests for Angular applications, utilizing Protractor, Jasmine, and Karma.
- Assisted with PR reviews.

positions.title: ALM Engineer
positions.description:
- Established automated DevOps release management pipelines which delivered tooling for next-generation application development efforts (the Dev) and on-going production operations (the Ops).
- Ensured development teams were provided a full set of DevOps ALM tools by leading the establishment of the right tooling and processes that resulted in fully automated release management pipelines to include: the automated build process, environment setups, testing scripts, deployments, and production operational metrics/debugging information.
- Partnered with development and operations teams and developed practical automation solutions as well as custom modules.  Troubleshoot automation issues and find practical solutions that moved projects forward in a timely manner.
- Became a trusted automation and tooling advisor for DevOps initiatives by providing objective, practical and relevant ideas, insights and advice.
- Planned, organized, and controlled multiple responsibilities to achieve project objectives; technically guided projects through to completion.
- Developed and owned KPIs to ensure performance is measured against expected business outcomes.
